authority_policy: Machine artifacts remain immutable proposals. Approval records human acceptance in image space only. Relative depth stays non-metric, and no CAD, hidden geometry, material or manufacturing truth is created.

source_quality.title: Source image quality
source_quality.question: Is the jewellery visible, in focus and sufficiently detailed?

normalization.title: Normalization
normalization.question: Does the normalized image preserve the complete object and detail?

view_semantics.title: View semantics
view_semantics.question: Does the assigned front/top/isometric/left/right view label match the image?

silhouette.title: Jewellery silhouette
silhouette.question: Does the mask include the complete object and exclude the background?

edges.title: Edges and fine detail
edges.question: Do the retained edges preserve visible boundaries and sculptural detail?

relative_depth.title: Relative depth plausibility
relative_depth.question: Is the near-to-far ordering visually plausible within this view?

depth_uncertainty.title: Depth uncertainty
depth_uncertainty.question: Does uncertainty highlight ambiguous boundaries and reflective/detail regions?

limitations: No physical dimensions or calibrated cameras are supplied.
Depth Anything V2 outputs are relative per-view proposals, not millimetres.
STL-1 contains rendered rings and does not provide production CAD or scan truth.
Silhouette approval does not create individual stone, prong, cavity or relief masks.
A separate paired photo-to-CAD dataset is still required for metric reconstruction.
